Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Emiliano Arnotti wrote:
> Just a question... If I use life boon on my Predator to keep him alive, can
> I oust me in the process to gain 1VP giving him all my pool?
> Tnx in advance...

No. You can give him all your pool, but (since you'll be ousted before
he gets the VP that should go to you) the Life Boon is burned (when
you're ousted) before it can steal the VP for you.

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) V:TES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.

Yep. The damn thing have been reworded, I think... this is the text of my
V:tES card:
"Master: out-of-turn. Give pool to a Methuselah with no pool to keep him or

It looks quite obvious. They are creating paths (Feral Heart, of Night, of

stated that FN want to give much more punch to independent clans (it won't
be difficult, specially for those Giovanni). The Path of Paradox will highly
